node.title: Conductor-256 full-unit circular basis
node.closure: published real class-number theorem, Kummer-Sinnott unit-index theorem, and exact specialization
node.statement: Every algebraic unit of Z[zeta_256], modulo mu_256, has a unique exponent vector in the 63 standard real circular units eta_a for odd 3<=a<=127. The full unit log lattice is therefore the explicit integer span of the sine-ratio matrix. This uses the unconditional theorem h(Q(zeta_256)^+)=1 and the prime-power Kummer-Sinnott unit-index formula.
node.notes: EXACT LITERATURE-BACKED LATTICE IDENTIFICATION 2026-07-29: Miller Theorem 2.1 is unconditional at conductor 256. This is a full-unit basis theorem, not the false assertion that the full cyclotomic field has class number one. No regulator estimate, lattice-point count, sparse-associate count, or E1 payment follows.
